findings.problem: The hint asks for a two-letter casual opener, but so also has two letters and works here ("So, wie geht's?"), and the hint only rules out also.
findings.fix: hint: casual opener for a greeting, two letters, not so or also

back.target: well, so (casual interjection to open a remark or greeting)

note: In Austria and Bavaria na also means "no" (short for nein), but that is a different meaning, so regional can stay null.
